messages.bodyText: Hello, our current contract expires at the end of September and we would like to discuss renewal terms in advance. Dingxin Software has seen strong business growth this year, and we hope to expand to additional modules upon renewal. Please arrange a time to meet. — Li Na, Dingxin Software

Hello, here is a quick update on the new module launched in January: the system has been running smoothly, user feedback has been positive, and daily active users are up 15%. We are very confident about our continued partnership. — Li Na, Dingxin Software

Hello, I need to raise an issue: over the past two weeks we submitted 3 tickets and the average response time exceeded 48 hours, which has seriously impacted our operations. Hanhai E-commerce is very dissatisfied with the current service quality and expects prompt improvement. — Zhang Qiang, Hanhai E-commerce

Hello, we heard you recently launched a data analytics module and we are very interested. Could you arrange a demo? Although our budget is limited, we would consider upgrading if the results are good. — Zhang Qiang, Hanhai E-commerce

Hello, Wantong Logistics has been using your system for two years now, and our Q1 operational efficiency improved by 20%. We especially appreciate the technical team's quick response to our customization requests. We plan to further expand the scope of our partnership in Q2. — Liu Wei, Wantong Logistics
